resources.name: Arduino Uno Rev3 Microcontroller Board
resources.description: The standard ATmega328P 16MHz board with 14 digital I/O pins, 6 analog inputs, and USB interface. Essential for robotics and IoT sensors.
resources.location_description: Cabinet A2, Shelf 1, Apex Embedded Systems Lab

resources.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (4GB RAM) Starter Kit
resources.description: Quad-core 64-bit ARM Cortex-A72 at 1.5GHz, dual 4K micro-HDMI, Gigabit Ethernet, USB 3.0. Includes 32GB microSD and power supply.
resources.location_description: Locker B-3, Embedded Systems Lab, Apex

resources.name: Rigol DS1054Z 50MHz 4-Channel Digital Storage Oscilloscope
resources.description: Four-channel 50MHz oscilloscope with 1GSa/s real-time sampling rate, 24Mpts deep memory, and 7-inch WVGA screen. Certified training required.

resources.name: STM32F103C8T6 ARM Cortex-M3 "Blue Pill" Dev Board
resources.description: 32-bit ARM Cortex-M3 core operating at 72MHz with 64KB Flash, 20KB SRAM, 2x SPI, 2x I2C, 3x USART, and 37 GPIO pins.

resources.name: MPU-6050 6-Axis Gyroscope & Accelerometer Module
resources.description: Combines 3-axis gyroscope and 3-axis accelerometer on the same silicon die together with an onboard Digital Motion Processor (DMP) over I2C.

resources.name: BME280 Precision Barometric Pressure & Humidity Sensor
resources.description: High-precision environmental digital sensor from Bosch Sensortec measuring temperature, barometric pressure, and relative humidity via I2C and SPI.

resources.name: VL53L0X Time-of-Flight (ToF) Laser Ranging Sensor Module
resources.description: State-of-the-art Time-of-Flight laser-ranging sensor measuring absolute distance up to 2m regardless of target reflectance, color, or surface roughness.

resources.name: AD8232 Single-Lead Heart Rate / ECG Monitor Module Kit
resources.description: Integrated signal conditioning block for ECG and biomedical instrumentation applications. Features instrumentation amplifier, right leg drive, and leads-off detection.

specifications.lead_pins: 3-lead electrode jack + RA, LA, RL pads

resources.name: Korad KD3005D 30V 5A Adjustable Linear DC Bench Power Supply
resources.description: Precision linear regulated laboratory power supply with dual 4-digit LED displays, constant voltage (CV) and constant current (CC) automatic crossover.

resources.name: NEMA 17 Bipolar Stepper Motor (42N.cm) + A4988 Driver Kit
resources.description: High torque 1.8° step angle (200 steps/rev) bipolar stepper motor paired with A4988 microstepping driver board for CNC, 3D printing, and robotics.

resources.name: DS18B20 Waterproof Stainless Steel Digital Temperature Probe
resources.description: Dallas 1-Wire digital temperature probe sealed in high quality 6x50mm stainless steel waterproof tube with 1-meter flexible silicone cable.

resources.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (8GB RAM) High-Performance SBC
resources.description: Flagship 8GB LPDDR4-3200 SDRAM single-board computer for edge AI vision, ROS2 robotics nodes, and local machine learning models.

resources.name: ESP-32 NodeMCU Wi-Fi & Dual-Mode Bluetooth Board (30-Pin)
resources.description: Dual-core 240MHz SoC with integrated 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 4.2 BLE, CP2102 USB-to-UART chip, and 30 pinout headers.

resources.name: Arduino Nano V3.0 (ATmega328P / CH340G) Breadboard MCU
resources.description: Compact, breadboard-friendly microcontroller board based on the ATmega328P. Features 14 digital I/O pins, 8 analog inputs, and mini-USB.

resources.name: ESP8266 NodeMCU Lua ESP-12E Wi-Fi Development Board
resources.description: Open-source firmware IoT development board based on ESP-12E Wi-Fi module. Ideal for low-cost smart home automation and MQTT sensors.

resources.name: Teensy 4.0 ARM Cortex-M7 @ 600MHz Development Board
resources.description: Fastest microcontroller available, powered by NXP i.MX RT1062 ARM Cortex-M7 at 600MHz with double-precision FPU and 1024K RAM.

resources.name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor Module (2cm - 400cm)
resources.description: Standard 40kHz sonar transmitter and receiver module providing 2cm to 400cm non-contact distance measurement with 3mm ranging accuracy.

resources.name: DHT22 / AM2302 High-Accuracy Digital Temp & Humidity Sensor
resources.description: Precision digital composite temperature and relative humidity sensor. Outstanding long-term stability and high accuracy (±0.5°C, ±2% RH).

resources.name: MQ-135 Hazardous Air Quality & Hazardous Gas Sensor Module
resources.description: SnO2 gas-sensitive sensor module for detecting harmful gases including NH3, NOx, alcohol, benzene, smoke, and CO2 in domestic and industrial atmospheres.

specifications.target_gases: NH3, NOx, Alcohol, Benzene, Smoke, CO2

resources.location_description: Chemical & Gas Cabinet G1, Vanguard Lab

resources.name: RC522 13.56MHz RFID / NFC Reader Kit with Key Fob & Card
resources.description: Highly integrated contactless read and write chip for communication at 13.56MHz. Supports ISO 14443A/Mifare tags with SPI interface.
resources.location_description: Security Hardware Tray R-2, Vanguard Makerspace

resources.name: MAX30102 High-Sensitivity Pulse Oximeter & Heart-Rate Sensor
resources.description: Integrated pulse oximetry and heart-rate monitor biosensor module. Includes internal LEDs, photodetectors, optical elements, and low-noise electronics.

resources.name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor v1.2 (Corrosion Resistant)
resources.description: Measures soil moisture levels by capacitive sensing rather than resistive sensing, making it immune to electrolysis and corrosion in long-term outdoor plants.

resources.name: Fluke 117 True-RMS Electrician Digital Multimeter
resources.description: Professional grade True-RMS digital multimeter with integrated VoltAlert non-contact AC voltage detector and AutoVolt automatic AC/DC voltage selection.
resources.location_description: Calibration Bench C1, Vanguard ECE Lab

resources.name: Siglent SDG1032X 30MHz Dual-Channel Arbitrary Function Generator
resources.description: Dual-channel 30MHz waveform generator with 150MSa/s sampling rate, 14-bit vertical resolution, and innovative EasyPulse technology.

specifications.waveforms: Sine, Square, Ramp, Pulse, Noise, Arb

resources.name: DHT11 Digital Temperature & Humidity Sensor Module
resources.description: Introductory calibrated digital temperature and humidity sensor with single-wire digital interface. Perfect for school weather stations.
resources.location_description: Component Box S-14, Horizon STEM Lab

resources.name: 4WD Smart Robot Car Chassis Kit with L298N Driver
resources.description: Double-deck acrylic chassis with 4 DC gear motors, rubber grip wheels, battery box, encoder discs, and L298N dual H-bridge driver.
resources.location_description: Robotics Shelf R3, Horizon STEM Academy

resources.name: Arduino Mega 2560 R3 Microcontroller Board
resources.description: ATmega2560 board with 54 digital input/output pins, 16 analog inputs, 4 hardware UART serial ports, and 256KB flash memory for complex robotics.

resources.name: Raspberry Pi Pico W with Wi-Fi (RP2040 Dual Cortex-M0+)
resources.description: Features Raspberry Pi custom RP2040 silicon with dual ARM Cortex-M0+ cores, 264KB SRAM, and Infineon CYW43439 2.4GHz Wi-Fi chip.
resources.location_description: Kit Box P-1, Horizon STEM Lab

resources.name: BBC micro:bit V2 Educational STEM Embedded Board
resources.description: Pocket-sized programmable computer with 5x5 LED display, 2 buttons, onboard MEMS microphone, speaker, touch logo, compass, and accelerometer.

resources.name: PIR Motion Sensor Module (HC-SR501) with Adjustable Delay
resources.description: Pyroelectric infrared passive sensor module with adjustable sensitivity and trigger delay potentiometers. Detects human body movement up to 7m.

resources.name: MQ-2 Smoke, Flammable Gas & LPG Detector Sensor Module
resources.description: Wide-band gas sensor sensitive to LPG, propane, methane, hydrogen, alcohol, smoke, and carbon monoxide with dual analog and digital comparator outputs.
resources.location_description: Gas Sensors Box, Horizon STEM Lab

resources.name: TCRT5000 Dual Infrared Line Tracking & Proximity Sensor
resources.description: Reflective optical infrared sensor with transistor output and built-in daylight blocking filter. Essential for line-following robot competitions.
resources.location_description: Robotics Tray T-1, Horizon STEM Lab

resources.name: LDR Photosensitive Light Intensity Sensor Module
resources.description: Photoresistor module with high sensitivity to ambient light. Features adjustable potentiometer threshold and dual digital/analog outputs.

specifications.output_format: Digital switching output (0 and 1) + AO analog

resources.location_description: Component Box L-1, Horizon STEM Lab

resources.name: Sound & Acoustic Microphone Detection Sensor Module
resources.description: High sensitivity electret microphone with LM393 amplifier and comparator. Trigger lights or motors via hand claps and sound thresholds.
resources.location_description: Acoustic Box A-2, Horizon STEM Lab

resources.name: SW-420 High Sensitivity Vibration & Shock Sensor Module
resources.description: Normally closed vibration sensor module for theft prevention, seismic alarms, and smart vehicle vibration detection with LM393 comparator.

resources.name: HX711 24-Bit ADC with 5kg Micro Precision Load Cell Kit
resources.description: Precision 24-bit analog-to-digital converter (ADC) designed specifically for weight scales and industrial control applications, paired with a 5kg aluminum load cell.
resources.location_description: Measurement Kit Box M-3, Horizon STEM Academy
